exampleSql.obj-01:
SELECT e.asset_tag, s.name, c.checked_out_at, c.returned_at
FROM checkouts c
JOIN equipment e ON e.id = c.equipment_id
JOIN staff s ON s.id = c.staff_id
WHERE e.asset_tag = 'TX-7'
exampleSql.obj-02:
SELECT DISTINCT c.card_number
FROM access_logs a
JOIN cards c ON c.id = a.card_id
JOIN doors d ON d.id = a.door_id
WHERE d.door_name = '第3研究室'
  AND a.occurred_at >= '2026-06-13 00:00:00'
  AND a.occurred_at <  '2026-06-13 06:00:00'
exampleSql.obj-03:
-- 同じカード・同じ扉で「ちょうど1つ前」の記録を掴み、向きが同じ行だけ残す
SELECT c.card_number, a.occurred_at, a.direction
FROM access_logs a
JOIN access_logs b
  ON  b.card_id = a.card_id
  AND b.door_id = a.door_id
  AND b.occurred_at < a.occurred_at
  AND b.direction = a.direction
JOIN cards c ON c.id = a.card_id
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM access_logs m
  WHERE m.card_id = a.card_id AND m.door_id = a.door_id
    AND m.occurred_at > b.occurred_at
    AND m.occurred_at < a.occurred_at)
ORDER BY a.occurred_at
exampleSql.obj-04:
SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) AS active_cards
FROM cards c
JOIN staff s ON s.id = c.holder_id
WHERE c.revoked_on IS NULL
GROUP BY s.id, s.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
exampleSql.obj-05:
SELECT c.card_number, a.direction, a.occurred_at
FROM access_logs a
JOIN cards c ON c.id = a.card_id
JOIN doors d ON d.id = a.door_id
WHERE c.card_number = 'C-1187'
  AND d.door_name = '正面玄関'
ORDER BY a.occurred_at
exampleSql.obj-06:
-- 02:47 より前の、そのカードの最後の記録が in なら、その人はまだ中にいる
SELECT s.name
FROM access_logs a
JOIN doors d ON d.id = a.door_id
JOIN cards c ON c.id = a.card_id
JOIN staff s ON s.id = c.holder_id
WHERE d.door_name = '正面玄関'
  AND a.direction = 'in'
  AND a.occurred_at <= '2026-06-13 02:47:00'
  AND a.occurred_at = (
    SELECT MAX(a2.occurred_at)
    FROM access_logs a2
    JOIN doors d2 ON d2.id = a2.door_id
    WHERE a2.card_id = a.card_id
      AND d2.door_name = '正面玄関'
      AND a2.occurred_at <= '2026-06-13 02:47:00')
ORDER BY s.name
exampleSql.obj-07:
SELECT s.name
FROM staff s
WHERE s.name IN ('久我山 慧', '早瀬 拓')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM access_logs a
    JOIN cards c ON c.id = a.card_id
    JOIN doors d ON d.id = a.door_id
    WHERE c.holder_id = s.id
      AND d.building = '研究棟')
